location_text: Outdoor restaurant table at San Pedro Square
summary: A diner's phone was grabbed from an outdoor table at around 9:30 p.m. The suspect fled on foot toward St. John Street; the victim was not injured.

location_text: From a bar in San Pedro Square for several blocks to a hotel lobby on Santa Clara Street
summary: A woman said a man who had been watching her inside a bar followed her for several blocks after she left. She went into a hotel lobby and called a friend; no arrest has been made.

location_text: Near the San Pedro Square Market entrance
summary: A fight that started inside a nearby bar spilled onto the sidewalk around 1 a.m. Two men were treated for minor injuries and one was cited for battery.

location_text: St. James Park, cutting through the park (walked toward 1st Street)
summary: A student reported being verbally harassed and blocked from leaving by a group of three people. The student walked away toward 1st Street.

location_text: Northeast corner of St. James Park, St. James and 3rd streets
summary: A cyclist was pushed off his bike and the bike was taken shortly after 7 p.m. The rider had scrapes, and the suspect rode off toward Julian Street.

location_text: VTA light rail southbound on 2nd Street, off at the Paseo de San Antonio area (date vague: 'one evening last week')
summary: A woman reported a man repeatedly touched her and made sexual comments on a southbound light rail train. She reported it to a VTA fare inspector, and VTA is reviewing camera footage.

location_text: Parking lot next to Diridon Station
summary: A laptop and backpack were stolen from a parked car after its rear window was smashed. Police said vehicle break-ins near the station have been reported several times this month.

Several people reported online a man approaching pedestrians and demanding money over the past few weeks, mostly at night. Police have received a handful of calls but no specific location is confirmed.

location_text: St. James Park near North 3rd Street
summary: A woman's purse was grabbed from her shoulder at about 11:40 p.m. The suspect ran north on 3rd Street and the woman was not hurt.

location_text: North 3rd Street edge of St. James Park
summary: A man walking along the park was punched by a stranger shortly after midnight and treated at the scene for a bloody nose. The attacker left on foot and has not been identified.

location_text: From light rail toward St. James Park along North 3rd Street, ending at 3rd and St. James streets
summary: A woman reported a man followed her from the light rail and kept pace with her along North 3rd Street around 12:30 a.m. The man walked away before officers arrived.

location_text: St. James Park near North 3rd Street
summary: Two students said a group of men shouted at them, made crude comments and tried to block their path at about 1 a.m. The students crossed the street and reported it to campus police.

location_text: Santa Clara Street light rail stop on 2nd Street
summary: A rider's phone was snatched from his hand at about 11:15 p.m. while he waited at the stop. The suspect ran east on Santa Clara Street.

location_text: Light rail platform on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: A woman said a man stood close to her, made sexual comments and would not leave her alone around midnight. VTA security escorted her onto the next train.

location_text: Light rail stop on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: An argument turned into a fight at about 12:45 a.m., leaving one person with minor injuries. Police detained one man at the scene.

location_text: Light rail stop on 1st Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: A backpack containing a laptop was taken from a bench at around 11:50 p.m. while its owner looked at the train schedule. Police are reviewing nearby camera footage.

location_text: 10 Almaden, a 17-story office building in downtown San Jose
summary: A man apparently broke into a downtown high-rise office building overnight on Oct. 14 and destroyed the lobby guard desk in a 22-minute vandalism spree, causing thousands of dollars in damage. Police are investigating and a main door remains boarded up.

location_text: From near the Paseo de San Antonio light rail stop toward 3rd Street, downtown San Jose
summary: A woman walking home around 11:30 p.m. on a Saturday reported that a man followed her for several blocks, repeatedly asking for her phone number, until she went into an open restaurant. Officers searched the area but did not find the man.
